algorithm: DFSPH (SPlisHSPlasH 2.19.0 formulation, warm start), Akinci 2012 boundary samples at 1.5 r thinned to a 0.6 x 1.5 r minimum spacing per body, Weiler 2018 implicit viscosity, Jeske 2023 surface tension; cubic spline kernel, support 4 r
origin: gpu/kernels.py and gpu/sampling.py are the adopted RoboCasa liquid 0.5.0 Warp kernels (robouse backends/robocasa/physics/liquid/gpu, commits 9ec9592, fe148db, 3dd4e1f), byte for byte; gpu/thinning.py is household (not adopted): the minimum-distance thinning of each mesh boundary's samples
notes: Household liquid contract 1.2.0. Needs a CUDA device; no CPU fallback.

Supersedes warp-1.19.0-dfsph-cuda-f32-v1 (kept unchanged): the vendored per-vertex/edge/face sampling stacks coincident samples at the pole of a revolved vessel (339-435 boundary neighbours against the 128 capacity). v2 keeps, per mesh boundary and in the vendored order, only samples at least boundary_min_spacing x 1.5 r from every kept one (gpu/thinning.py). Kernels, vendored sampler, solver and neighbour capacities are v1's; boundaries with their own samples (the work-surface plate) are used as given.
Domain, continuous contact, validity, time step, absorbers, accounting, queries and surface run on the host, as the CPU contract.
